title: Virginia court settles family dispute over Smith Mountain Lake home and inherited ownership shares
summary_full: A legal conflict concerning a Virginia lakeside property has escalated to the state's Court of Appeals. The court determined that Joan Cabaniss holds a 50% ownership share, while her late husband's children retain the remaining half through his will. Disputes over inheritance and property rights, including a contested quitclaim deed from one child, have been addressed.
